verdict.rationale: smolagents' own docs say it ships command-line utilities (smolagent, webagent) for running agents without writing boilerplate, which directly covers running agents from a terminal. That evidence is a single summary line. The pack also shows agents run programmatically via agent.run(), and a community user describes running the text_to_sql example, but neither shows a terminal command. missing for 10: CLI flag/usage docs, evidence of non-interactive headless output or exit codes for automated verification, documented commands for running the bundled example agents, independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can run the framework's example agents headlessly from a terminal so an agent can verify what it just built

citations.quote: CLI Tools: Comes with command-line utilities (smolagent, webagent) for quickly running agents without writing boilerplate code.
